Band door for 90.50.10.0401-0499 (t413u: a page ending in 00 is the band door; you enter here, find the work, and complete it within the band). No work is done on this page and it drafts no passes.
Registry (work in this band):
- 90.50.10.0401  wf: builder prompt says wf.exe (job 1). Start origin/wf-functional.
- 90.50.10.0402  wf: init-page refuses invalid work addresses (job 2). Start origin/returns after job 1 lands.
wf has no face 00 or registry yet, so face 01 holds the band registry by hand (glitch, t413u). The grant docs/ is a placeholder because init-page needs one; no pass will be drafted here.

Band door for 90.50.10.0401-0498 (t413u: the page ending in 00 is where you enter the band and find its work). No work is done on this page and it drafts no passes.
Temporary: this registry is written by hand because wf v0 has no face 00 type or registry. It is replaced when wf writes type: band and a compute-made contents list on face 00 (that wf job is not packed yet; it will be named here when it is). Release check: docs/review/RELEASE-CHECK-90.50.10.md.
Registry (work in this band):
- 90.50.10.0401  dropped, never released. It repeated job 1 (builder prompt says wf.exe), which landed and closed passed on 90.50.00.0001.05.01 (commit 439a4eb2, on returns at 60dd7e25).
- 90.50.10.0402  dropped, never released. Superseded by 0403: it lacked the 99/PP99/9999 refusals (RELEASE-CHECK-90.50.10).
- 90.50.10.0403  live: wf init-page refuses invalid work addresses (00-09 and 99 on any axis, pages 0000-0099, NN00, NN99, 9999), with --system and a ref for system pages. Start origin/returns 60dd7e25.
Tension: the grant docs/ is a placeholder because init-page needs a grant; this page drafts no pass, and the grant should be narrowed by Matthew to a path nothing writes.

Band door for 90.50.10.0401-0498. You enter the band here and find its work (t413u; the band head is the door, t420). No work is done on this page and it drafts no passes.
Temporary: this card is written by hand because wf cannot yet print a door's type and contents. It is replaced when page 0407 closes passed and wf prints them from the pages. Until then, if this card and a page's own log disagree, the page's log is right.
Goal line (Matthew, t423u): "Workshop: A place models, persons, and compute work. With kanban style boards to integrate our kernel, pages, desk, faces, seqaddr designs. So whys can be captured and reused to strengthen over time."
Stage: roadmap stage 1 of stages 0-9, "WF for daily use". This band is the stage (t423u). Full plan: docs/design/STAGE-PLAN-90.50.10.md (v5), in the build repo; it replaces the roadmap's old stage 1 list (t424).
How it runs: each page is checked against the design first, then loops pass by pass until it meets its own MVP goal (t423u). Each work page links to its lab in the lab band 0700-0799, door 90.50.10.0700 (t432u, t434); stage 1's lab is 90.50.10.0701, the wf loop lab, where another view tries to break the work. Work pages copy no test code (t425u). Two pages run at once only if neither needs the other and they change no shared files (t422).
Registry (state as of this version; needs are written on both pages):
- 0401  dropped, never released. It repeated job 1, which closed passed on 90.50.00.0001.05.01.
- 0402  dropped, never released. Superseded by 0403 (it lacked the 99/PP99/9999 refusals).
- 0403  closed passed (Cursor-1, 05.01; returns c09fa60c): init-page refuses invalid work addresses. Needed by 0407, 0498, lab 0701.
- 0404  planned: returns state a design review (t416u). First work page after the lab's first pass. Needs lab 0701. Needed by 0498.
- 0405  not used. It was planned as the Windows tests job, which moved to the lab's first pass because it is test code (t425u).
- 0406  planned: needs links on both pages. Needs lab 0701. Needed by 0498.
- 0407  planned: the door prints its own type and contents. Needs 0403, lab 0701. Needed by 0498.
- 0408  planned: withdraw a packed pass nobody claimed. Needs lab 0701. Needed by 0409, 0498.
- 0409  planned: retire a page. Needs 0408, lab 0701. Needed by 0498.
- 0410  not used. It was planned as the packs-head check, which waits until the whole build is done (t424).
- 0411  planned: the real runner starts a page and Matthew grants it (t424). Needs lab 0701. Needed by 0498.
- 0412  planned: the real runner records Matthew's grant and cites his words file (t432). Needs lab 0701. Needed by 0498.
- 0497  not used. It was planned as the band's test lab, which moved to its own band (lab 0701, door 0700; t432u).
- 0498  planned: the tie-it-together page, one working wf Matthew can use and test (t423u, t424). Needs 0403, 0404, 0406-0409, 0411, 0412 and lab 0701.
Planned pages are not made yet; each gets its own page, grant and pack when its turn comes.
Stage end: every page closed passed and checked by another view; then a hostile pass, this door halts and Matthew gets a short report; then Matthew says go, hold or redo (t422).
Tension: the grant docs/ is a placeholder because init-page needs a grant; this page drafts no pass, and the grant should be narrowed by Matthew to a path nothing writes.
